title: Help overlay polish: pgup inverts pgdown, scroll keys in the narrow hint, mouse wheel scrolls help

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261122-081958-ba4a for S401 (discovered from S401):

Make pgup the exact inverse of pgdown in help
pgup steps by the current window's visible count (`model.go:845-846`). From offset 0, pgdown moves to 18 at 80x24. pgup from 18 steps back 17 (both markers are shown) and lands on offset 1, so the top takes two presses. This meets the spec, but the human check asks for smooth paging.
Importance: 1
Urgency: 1
Effort: 1

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): What does the help hint show below 80 columns while the help overflows? -> keep scroll, drop quit: at 60x16 show the scroll hint and the close hint, and drop `q quit` first [ui.help-narrow-hint]. How far does one mouse-wheel notch scroll the help, and is the wheel on only when mouse mode is on? -> one line, mouse-gated: one notch moves `helpOffset` by 1 line, like up/down. It works only when `m.mouse` is on (adj 129, mouse is off by default). [ui.help-wheel-step]. How should this slice's empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check sections be filled so done can be verified? -> tighten: I draft the sections. Files are `internal/tui/model.go`, `internal/tui/keys.go`, the help test file and the goldens. Named failing tests assert (a) pgup from the page-down offset returns to offset 0 in one press at 80x24, (b) the 60x16 hint contains the scroll keys, and (c) a wheel-down message raises `helpOffset` while `showHelp` is true. The check is `go test ./internal/tui` and `go test ./...`, exit 0, plus `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` with empty output..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: (a) pgup from the pgdown offset returns to offset 0 in one press; (b) the 60x16 help hint contains the scroll keys and the close hint and drops "q quit"; (c) a wheel-down raises helpOffset by one line while showHelp is true and mouse is on.
- `go test ./internal/tui`
- `go test ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
